title:
Triggered when a user closes alerts, and triggers actions for the following:
- Refresh To Do Alerts Overview Definition List.
- Shows a banner message with information regarding the number of alerts that were closed,
  and the open remaining alerts.

Expected payload:
- `alertsToBeClosed`: The alerts that were closed, this value should be emitted from {@link UiSdlEpicCloseBatchAlerts}
- `stateId`: Application State Id
- `overviewId`: The To Do Alerts Overview Definition Id to refresh.
- `bannerId`: The banner Id to show the message.
name: ToDoAlertsAfterCloseAlertsEpic
